How to read this

Prototype, not a final audit

  • The sample contains 20 prominent commitments from each manifesto. It is curated, not random, so the percentages describe this sample only.
  • Completed means the promised outcome was delivered at the stated or substantially equivalent scope. Partial means action occurred but the outcome, scale or wording changed. Not completed includes promises with no verified delivery by the cutoff.
  • AIADMK is assessed at the end of its 2016–2021 term. DMK is assessed against evidence available on 25 September 2026. Each row links to its principal evidence; government claims are treated as claims unless independently corroborated.
  • The next production step should audit every manifesto promise with two reviewers, archived primary documents, a dated change log and a public correction process.
